content.text: The maximum-data stress case used too much memory with one dictionary entry per byte. I’m replacing that with block-based sparse storage and transactional bit/byte undo, preserving the same overlap and delivery semantics.

python3 - <<'PY'
p='/app/submission/entry.py'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index('class StreamState:')
end=s.index('class Transaction:')
new='''BLOCK_SHIFT = 8
BLOCK_SIZE = 1 << BLOCK_SHIFT
MASK_SIZE = BLOCK_SIZE // 8


class ByteStore:
    """Sparse bytes with a presence bitmap in each 256-byte block."""

    __slots__ = ("blocks",)

    def __init__(self):
        self.blocks = {}

    def get(self, position):
        block = self.blocks.get(position >> BLOCK_SHIFT)
        if block is None:
            return None
        index = position & (BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
        if not (block[1][index >> 3] & (1 << (index & 7))):
            return None
        return block[0][index]

    def insert(self, position, value):
        block_index = position >> BLOCK_SHIFT
        block = self.blocks.get(block_index)
        created = block is None
        if created:
            block = [bytearray(BLOCK_SIZE), bytearray(MASK_SIZE)]
            self.blocks[block_index] = block
        index = position & (BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
        block[0][index] = value
        block[1][index >> 3] |= 1 << (index & 7)
        return created

    def clear(self, position):
        block = self.blocks[position >> BLOCK_SHIFT]
        index = position & (BLOCK_SIZE - 1)
        block[0][index] = 0
        block[1][index >> 3] &= ~(1 << (index & 7))

    def extend(self, target):
        while True:
            value = self.get(len(target))
            if value is None:
                return
            target.append(value)


class StreamState:
    __slots__ = ("highest", "final_size", "reset", "stopped", "delivered", "data")

    def __init__(self):
        self.highest = 0
        self.final_size = None
        self.reset = False
        self.stopped = False
        self.delivered = bytearray()
        self.data = ByteStore()


class CryptoState:
    __slots__ = ("highest", "contiguous", "data")

    def __init__(self):
        self.highest = 0
        self.contiguous = bytearray()
        self.data = ByteStore()


'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
s=s.replace('__slots__ = ("receiver", "streams", "cryptos", "inserted", "received_total")',
            '__slots__ = ("receiver", "streams", "cryptos", "inserted", "created", "received_total")')
s=s.replace('        self.inserted = []\n        self.received_total', '        self.inserted = []\n        self.created = []\n        self.received_total')

s=s.replace('self.cryptos[level] = (state.highest, state.contiguous)',

s=s.replace('''    def insert(self, data, offset, value):

        self.inserted.append((data, offset))
''','''    def insert(self, data, offset, value):

''')

            del state.contiguous[contiguous_length:]
''')
# Remove obsolete prefix static method.

    def _advance_prefix(data, start):
        while start in data:
            start += 1
        return start

'''
assert old in s

s=s.replace('stream.delivered = self._advance_prefix(stream.data, stream.delivered)',
            'stream.data.extend(stream.delivered)')
s=s.replace('state.contiguous = self._advance_prefix(state.data, state.contiguous)',
            'state.data.extend(state.contiguous)')
s=s.replace('delivered = bytes(stream.data[offset] for offset in range(stream.delivered))',
            'delivered = stream.delivered')
s=s.replace('contiguous = bytes(state.data[offset] for offset in range(state.contiguous))',
            'contiguous = state.contiguous')
# Remove the unused duplicate processing implementation.
start=s.index('    def _semantics(self, frames):')
end=s.index('    def _process_packet(self, record, time):',start)
